notes.title: Patch 1.3 is out now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/1ad37831a6393f9f33f819c7702cefa6aff224ce.jpg

Dear players, 

Patch 1.3 is now live and ready to improve several aspects of Unholy’s experience. 

Let’s see together all the improvements available right now: 


 After being chased and hiding in the locker Dorothea will be executed by the enemy (Guards, Plagueman, Hunters)  
 Adding mouse smoothing option in the menu  
 Collision fixes in Inner Monastery main compound  
 Sister no longer should block Guards from passing her  
 Fix for navigation in the administration building on the Priest Plaza Level  
 Improved system to check if the enemy went out of the navmesh  
 Fix for restoring blocker in the Church Complex library  
 Better player noticing for the AI in very dark areas  
 Various tweaks and improvements to sounds 


We hope those fixes and improvements can make your own journey to the Eternal City even more unforgettable. 

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is out now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/ed0e6e8db96c9d9de53db54af6e62ef9e10d4f68.png

Dear players,

The patch 1.2 for Unholy is live and ready for download. 

Thanks to your feedback, we were able to improve many aspects of Unholy’s gameplay, make several improvements, and fix some of the bugs you reported to us.

The following are all the fixes implemented right now:


 Better pathfinding for Infected and Hunters. This means that the issue where Infected, while chasing the player in the Office, would go to a different floor instead of running towards the player, is resolved.
 Securing Vent Spawners from NPC glitching. Sometimes NPCs would abruptly stop exiting the Vent and get stuck inside the wall.
 When the player is in a locker, enemies will immediately enter Blind Chase mode instead of running into a wall or staring at the locker.
 Restores now trigger a Sensing Reset, so NPCs won't "know" what they knew before.
 Infected rotation is precise to the Player. They won't take 45-degree steps four times to turn around 180 degrees, but they will turn 180 degrees precisely towards the Player they are chasing.
 Sisters no longer make Guards stuck if they want to pass them. 
 Fixed a bug where enemies would not properly exit the vents in the City Hall area in Chapter V
 Fixed a bug where Guards could get stuck in certain place in Chapter V Square arena
 Fixed a bug where Players could jump over a ladder and avoid the dialogue with trapped citizen in Chapter V Slums
 Various improvements to various sounds during the game
 Various fixes

With all these improvements, we hope to make the experience better for all of you. Let us know what you think. 

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/7381e6f78dea379068b5850f8541215a083929b5.png

Dear players,

As announced a few days ago, we are now ready to publish our first update for the Eternal City.

Thanks to your feedback, we were able to improve many aspects of Unholy’s gameplay, make several improvements, and fix some of the bugs you reported to us.

The following are all the fixes implemented right now:


 Optimization: Second Floor of Chapter X
 Improving the slide tutorial mechanics so players will not get stuck.
 Restore fix so you cannot see the unstreamed level at Chapter 3 after the restore.
 Removing a bug that caused the slingshot to hide unintentionally in Chapter X
 Removing a bug that causes Dorothea to breathe during the outro sequence.
 Removing a bug with sounds during the Pit sequence in Chapter VII 
 Adding occlusion to a sound of an exploding mine
 The flashlight state will be saved if the player takes out the slingshot.
 Collision issues in Chapter X
 Corrupted materials in chapters V and VII
 AI improvements - Guards glitching on equipping a weapon.
 AI improvements -Guards is not correctly recognizing player on a Burning Plaza in Chapter 3
 AI Improvements - Improved rotating for Sister character
 AI Improvements - Guards are now better at notifying each other.
 Making clearer that exploding barrel has to explode in Distillery in Chapter III
 Increasing visibility of new tutorials entries on HUD and in the menu
 Improving UI - visibility of the controls to switch ammunitions.
 Adding the option to switch ammunition without having to take out the slingshot.
 Ongoing optimization
 AI improvements: Enemies are more efficient in going around each other and not getting stuck.
 Improvements to handling switching masks and slingshot.
 Various improvements to various sounds during the game
 Various fixes

With all these improvements, we hope to make the experience better for all of you. Meanwhile, we are working on more fixes and refinements for the next patch.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Unholy Patch 1.1 is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Unholy - Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/7381e6f78dea379068b5850f8541215a083929b5.png

The Spring of Eternity is about to unveil its secrets; Unholy and its twisted realities will officially land on Steam July the 20th!

[previewyoutube=pMq-6a-d3H8;full](Trailer)[/previewyoutube]
In Unholy, you’ll be able to help Dorothea in the search for her missing child while traverse between unsettling and dangerous realities.

Use your emotions and the masks powers to carve your way through the many difficulties lies ahead, solve puzzles scattered through your path, and unveil the mystery behind the disappearance of your child.

Unholy’s demo is already available and you can taste Dorothea’s challenges in several spoiler-free and carefully selected areas.

We truly hope you will enjoy Unholy, and if you like it please add it to your wishlist and spread the word!

Thank you

notes.title: Unholy's Demo Release Date
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32241287/7381e6f78dea379068b5850f8541215a083929b5.png

We are thrilled to share with you that the first Unholy’s demo is around the corner! Save the date, from June the 12th you’ll be able to take your very first steps in the many realities of Dorothea’s journey.

[previewyoutube=zz-iG5SSHec;full][/previewyoutube]
This demo will introduce you the struggle behind Dorothea’s choices and challenge you with several disturbing area, each spoiler free and carefully selected. In those zones, you’ll be able to take familiarity with many key features of Unholy, like the masks characteristics and how to weaponize and use Dorothea’s emotions.

We are eager to know what you think about this demo, and if you like Unholy please don’t forget to spread the word and add it to the wishlist.

Thanks!
